title: Complaints to the Secretary
clause_text: (a) Right to file a complaint. A person who believes a covered entity or busi ness associate is not complying with the administrative simplification pro visions may file a complaint with the Secretary. (b) Requirements for filing complaints. Complaints under this section must meet the following requirements: (1) A complaint must be filed in writ ing, either on paper or electronically. (2) A complaint must name the per son that is the subject of the complaint and describe the acts or omissions be lieved to be in violation of the applica ble administrative simplification pro vision(s). (3) A complaint must be filed within 180 days of when the complainant knew or should have known that the act or omission complained of occurred, un less this time limit is waived by the Secretary for good cause shown. (4) The Secretary may prescribe addi tional procedures for the filing of com plaints, as well as the place and man ner of filing, by notice in the F EDERAL REGISTER

title: Applicability
clause_text: A covered entity and business associate must comply with the applicable standards, implementation specifications, and requirements of this subpart.
norm_text: a covered entity and business associate must comply with the applicable standards, implementation specifications, and requirements of this subpart.

title: Definitions
clause_text: As used in this subpart, definitions apply to the terms including administrative safeguards, addressable, authentication, availability, confidentiality, integrity, and security incident.
norm_text: as used in this subpart, definitions apply to the terms including administrative safeguards, addressable, authentication, availability, confidentiality, integrity, and security incident.

title: General requirements: CIA of ePHI
clause_text: Ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all electronic protected health information the covered entity or business associate creates, receives, maintains, or transmits.
norm_text: ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all electronic protected health information the covered entity or business associate creates, receives, maintains, or transmits.

title: General requirements: threats or hazards
clause_text: Protect against any reasonably anticipated threats or hazards to the security or integrity of such information.
norm_text: protect against any reasonably anticipated threats or hazards to the security or integrity of such information.

title: General requirements: impermissible uses or disclosures
clause_text: Protect against any reasonably anticipated uses or disclosures of such information that are not permitted or required under subpart E of this part.
norm_text: protect against any reasonably anticipated uses or disclosures of such information that are not permitted or required under subpart e of this part.

title: General requirements: workforce compliance
clause_text: Ensure compliance with this subpart by its workforce.
norm_text: ensure compliance with this subpart by its workforce.

title: Flexibility of approach: factors
clause_text: In deciding which security measures to use, take into account the size, complexity, and capabilities of the covered entity or business associate; the technical infrastructure, hardware, and software security capabilities; the costs of security measures; and the probability and criticality of potential risks to electronic protected health information.
norm_text: in deciding which security measures to use, take into account the size, complexity, and capabilities of the covered entity or business associate; the technical infrastructure, hardware, and software security capabilities; the costs of security measures; and the probability and criticality of potential risks to electronic protected health information.

title: Risk analysis
clause_text: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity or business associate.
norm_text: conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity or business associate.

title: Risk management
clause_text: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level to comply with § 164.306(a).
norm_text: implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level to comply with § 164.306(a).

title: Sanction policy
clause_text: Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies and procedures of the covered entity or business associate.
norm_text: apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies and procedures of the covered entity or business associate.

title: Information system activity review
clause_text: Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.
norm_text: implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.

title: Assigned security responsibility
clause_text: Identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required by this subpart for the entity.
norm_text: identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required by this subpart for the entity.

title: Workforce security
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of its workforce have appropriate access to electronic protected health information, as provided under § 164.308(a)(4), and to prevent those workforce members who do not have access from obtaining access to electronic protected health information.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of its workforce have appropriate access to electronic protected health information, as provided under § 164.308(a)(4), and to prevent those workforce members who do not have access from obtaining access to electronic protected health information.

title: Authorization and/or supervision
clause_text: Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with electronic protected health information or in locations where it might be accessed.
norm_text: implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with electronic protected health information or in locations where it might be accessed.

title: Workforce clearance procedure
clause_text: Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to electronic protected health information is appropriate.
norm_text: implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to electronic protected health information is appropriate.

title: Termination procedures
clause_text: Implement procedures for terminating access to electronic protected health information when the employment of a workforce member ends or as required by determinations under § 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(B).
norm_text: implement procedures for terminating access to electronic protected health information when the employment of a workforce member ends or as required by determinations under § 164.308(a)(3)(ii)(b).

title: Information access management
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information that are consistent with the applicable requirements of subpart E of this part.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information that are consistent with the applicable requirements of subpart e of this part.

title: Isolating health care clearinghouse functions
clause_text: If a health care clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, implement policies and procedures that protect the electronic protected health information of the clearinghouse from unauthorized access by the larger organization.
norm_text: if a health care clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, implement policies and procedures that protect the electronic protected health information of the clearinghouse from unauthorized access by the larger organization.

title: Access authorization
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism.

title: Access establishment and modification
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures that, based upon the covered entity’s or the business associate’s access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user’s right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures that, based upon the covered entity’s or the business associate’s access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user’s right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.

title: Security awareness and training
clause_text: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of its workforce (including management).
norm_text: implement a security awareness and training program for all members of its workforce (including management).

title: Security reminders
clause_text: Implement periodic security updates.
norm_text: implement periodic security updates.

title: Protection from malicious software
clause_text: Implement procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.
norm_text: implement procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.

title: Log-in monitoring
clause_text: Implement procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.
norm_text: implement procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.

title: Password management
clause_text: Implement procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.
norm_text: implement procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.

title: Security incident procedures
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.

title: Response and reporting
clause_text: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate, to the extent practicable, harmful effects of security incidents that are known to the covered entity or business associate; and document security incidents and their outcomes.
norm_text: identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate, to the extent practicable, harmful effects of security incidents that are known to the covered entity or business associate; and document security incidents and their outcomes.

title: Contingency plan
clause_text: Establish (and implement as needed) policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence (for example, fire, vandalism, system failure, and natural disaster) that damages systems that contain electronic protected health information.
norm_text: establish (and implement as needed) policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence (for example, fire, vandalism, system failure, and natural disaster) that damages systems that contain electronic protected health information.

title: Data backup plan
clause_text: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.
norm_text: establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.

title: Disaster recovery plan
clause_text: Establish and implement procedures to restore any loss of data.
norm_text: establish and implement procedures to restore any loss of data.

title: Emergency mode operation plan
clause_text: Establish and implement procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes for protection of the security of electronic protected health information while operating in emergency mode.
norm_text: establish and implement procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes for protection of the security of electronic protected health information while operating in emergency mode.

title: Testing and revision procedures
clause_text: Implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.
norm_text: implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.

title: Applications and data criticality analysis
clause_text: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of other contingency plan components.
norm_text: assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of other contingency plan components.

title: Evaluation
clause_text: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation, based initially upon the standards implemented under this subpart and subsequently, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of electronic protected health information, that establishes the extent to which an entity’s security policies and procedures meet the requirements of this subpart.
norm_text: perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation, based initially upon the standards implemented under this subpart and subsequently, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of electronic protected health information, that establishes the extent to which an entity’s security policies and procedures meet the requirements of this subpart.

title: Business associate contracts and other arrangements
clause_text: A covered entity, in accordance with § 164.306, may permit a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit electronic protected health information on the covered entity’s behalf only if the covered entity obtains satisfactory assurances, in accordance with § 164.314(a), that the business associate will appropriately safeguard the information.
norm_text: a covered entity, in accordance with § 164.306, may permit a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit electronic protected health information on the covered entity’s behalf only if the covered entity obtains satisfactory assurances, in accordance with § 164.314(a), that the business associate will appropriately safeguard the information.

title: Facility access controls
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to electronic information systems and the facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to electronic information systems and the facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.

title: Contingency operations
clause_text: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency.
norm_text: establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency.

title: Facility security plan
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.

title: Access control and validation procedures
clause_text: Implement procedures to control and validate a person’s access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision.
norm_text: implement procedures to control and validate a person’s access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision.

title: Maintenance records
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks).
norm_text: implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks).

title: Workstation use
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information.

title: Workstation security
clause_text: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users.
norm_text: implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users.

title: Device and media controls
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.

title: Disposal
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.

title: Media re-use
clause_text: Implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.
norm_text: implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.

title: Accountability
clause_text: Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefor.
norm_text: maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefor.

title: Data backup and storage
clause_text: Create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment.
norm_text: create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment.

title: Access control
clause_text: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights as specified in § 164.308(a)(4).
norm_text: implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights as specified in § 164.308(a)(4).

title: Unique user identification
clause_text: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.
norm_text: assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.

title: Emergency access procedure
clause_text: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency.
norm_text: establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency.

title: Automatic logoff
clause_text: Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.
norm_text: implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.

title: Encryption and decryption
clause_text: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information.
norm_text: implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information.

title: Audit controls
clause_text: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information.
norm_text: implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information.

title: Integrity
clause_text: Implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.
norm_text: implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.

title: Mechanism to authenticate electronic protected health information
clause_text: Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that electronic protected health information has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.
norm_text: implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that electronic protected health information has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.

title: Person or entity authentication
clause_text: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed.
norm_text: implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed.

title: Transmission security
clause_text: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
norm_text: implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.

title: Integrity controls
clause_text: Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted electronic protected health information is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.
norm_text: implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted electronic protected health information is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.

title: Encryption
clause_text: Implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information whenever deemed appropriate.
norm_text: implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information whenever deemed appropriate.

title: Business associate contracts or other arrangements
clause_text: The contract or other arrangement required by § 164.308(b) must meet the applicable requirements of this section.
norm_text: the contract or other arrangement required by § 164.308(b) must meet the applicable requirements of this section.

title: Business associate contracts—Elements
clause_text: Provide that the business associate will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the covered entity, as required by this subpart.
norm_text: provide that the business associate will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the covered entity, as required by this subpart.

title: Business associate contracts—Reporting and termination
clause_text: Provide that the business associate will report to the covered entity any security incident of which it becomes aware, and authorize termination if the covered entity determines that the business associate has violated a material term.
norm_text: provide that the business associate will report to the covered entity any security incident of which it becomes aware, and authorize termination if the covered entity determines that the business associate has violated a material term.

title: Requirements for group health plans
clause_text: Except when the only electronic protected health information disclosed to a plan sponsor is disclosed pursuant to § 164.504(f)(1)(ii) or (iii), a group health plan must ensure that its plan documents provide that the plan sponsor will reasonably and appropriately safeguard electronic protected health information created, received, maintained, or transmitted to or by the plan sponsor on behalf of the group health plan.
norm_text: except when the only electronic protected health information disclosed to a plan sponsor is disclosed pursuant to § 164.504(f)(1)(ii) or (iii), a group health plan must ensure that its plan documents provide that the plan sponsor will reasonably and appropriately safeguard electronic protected health information created, received, maintained, or transmitted to or by the plan sponsor on behalf of the group health plan.

title: Implementation specifications for group health plans
clause_text: Plan documents must be amended to incorporate provisions to ensure that the plan sponsor will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the group health plan.
norm_text: plan documents must be amended to incorporate provisions to ensure that the plan sponsor will implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the electronic protected health information that it creates, receives, maintains, or transmits on behalf of the group health plan.

title: Policies and procedures
clause_text: Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, or other requirements of this subpart, taking into account the factors specified in § 164.306(b)(2)(i), (ii), and (iii).
norm_text: implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, or other requirements of this subpart, taking into account the factors specified in § 164.306(b)(2)(i), (ii), and (iii).

title: Documentation
clause_text: Maintain the policies and procedures implemented to comply with this subpart in written (which may be electronic) form; and if an action, activity or assessment is required, document and retain it in written (which may be electronic) form.
norm_text: maintain the policies and procedures implemented to comply with this subpart in written (which may be electronic) form; and if an action, activity or assessment is required, document and retain it in written (which may be electronic) form.

title: Time limit
clause_text: Retain the documentation required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section for six years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later.
norm_text: retain the documentation required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section for six years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later.

title: Availability
clause_text: Make documentation available to those persons responsible for implementing the procedures to which the documentation pertains.
norm_text: make documentation available to those persons responsible for implementing the procedures to which the documentation pertains.

title: Updates to documentation
clause_text: Review documentation periodically, and update as needed, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of the electronic protected health information.
norm_text: review documentation periodically, and update as needed, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of the electronic protected health information.
